4000004623267ec7.meaning: The upgrade track a ladder draws: a list of checkpoints (item rating, UI quality). The Item Upgrade window draws each checkpoint on its vertical track bar at (rating - min) / (max - min) of the bar height, labelled with the rating in the colour of the UI quality. UI quality is the HSL enum ITM_QUALITY (NONE 0, CHEAP 1, STANDARD 2, PREMIUM 3, PROTOTYPE 4, ARTIFACT 5, LEGENDARY 6, LEGACY 7, QUEST 8, CURRENCY 9, MODDABLE 10), which is why it equals itmBaseQuality + 1 on 81 of 83 pairs. The two expertise-augment checkpoints use 6 and so show in Legendary colour, although the items are prototype and artifact.
4000004623267ec7.evidence: The PTS client's publictest/retailclient/main_gfx_1.tor holds /resources/gfx/gfx_production/ui_hud.gfx (CFX, AS2). Its ItemUpgrade class defines getUpgradeTrackData(_maxY), disassembled with gfx_as2_disasm.py. The function calls r3 = ExternalInterface.call('getsItemUpgradeTrack', selectedItem.getSpecId()), a flat array. It sets minRating = r3[0] and maxRating = r3[length - 2], then for each pair pushes {rating: r3[i], label: Util.formatHtmlText(String(rating), false, ColorUtility.getQualityColorString(r3[i + 1]), 10), normalized: MathUtility.normalize(rating, min, diff, true), yPos: _maxY * normalized} into _upgradeTrackData.upgrades. getQualityColorString(q) returns '#' + getQualityColor(q).toString(16), and getQualityColor branches on HSLEnums.Enums.ITM_QUALITY_*, defined in the same movie as NONE 0 .. MODDABLE 10. The array shape (rating, quality pairs, min first, ceiling last) and the key (the item's upgrade spec) are those of 23267ec7 under the rule that itmUpgradeSpec selects. The movie also reads getsItemUpgradeCost and getsHasArtifactAuthorizationPaidPermission.

400003d3acf26f20.evidence: True on 8 of 16 hook types, all floor-like: Floor Small, Floor Medium, Floor Large, Floor Medium Narrow, Massive Structure, Starship, Centerpiece, Floor Covering.
